references.role: Edit target: lighter scout; seven legs visible and one hidden

prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make ONE local correction to this exact light eight-legged observation robot. Reveal its currently hidden REAR RIGHT walking leg as a complete slender jointed rod leg extending out behind the right side of its abdomen into the empty UPPER-RIGHT area of the picture, with a sharp foot fully visible. Its root attaches to the far rear-right side of the chassis; its bent segments angle up/right in the picture before descending to its foot. The other SEVEN currently visible walking legs must remain unchanged. Result: EIGHT walking legs total, four visible feet per side. Keep the slim observation-focused body, all optical sensors, top camera pod, exactly TWO rear antennae, rust/olive colours, pose, background, framing and all existing equipment unchanged. Do not add any other limbs or duplicate antennae. Full body with all leg tips inside margins.
